dedupe_keys.name: grid to grid model estimates of monthly mean flow and soil moisture for great britain 1891 to 2015 observed driving data marius g2g oudin monthly

description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes MaRIUS-G2G-Oudin-monthly for spatial drought and water-scarcity analysis. The Grid-to-Grid model estimates monthly mean river flow in cubic metres per second and soil moisture in millimetres of water per metre of soil, on a 1 km grid across Great Britain during 1891–2015. Driving inputs are CEH-GEAR rainfall and temperature-based Oudin potential evaporation. NetCDF files are accompanied by derived catchment areas and gauging-station locations, including a CSV table. The EIDC record uses the UKCEH Click-Through Licence, with royalty-free personal or internal business use and restrictions on redistribution and commercial derivatives. File access was not attempted. Monthly averaging limits the dataset’s suitability for short flood peaks or drainage design events. The fields are model estimates, with input and structural uncertainty. They could supply spatial drought forcing for irrigation or water-allocation simulations after unit and grid checks. This resource complements the daily MaRIUS catchment series with mapped soil moisture and flow across ungauged cells.
name: Grid-to-Grid model estimates of monthly mean flow and soil moisture for Great Britain (1891 to 2015): observed driving data [MaRIUS-G2G-Oudin-monthly]
